mentions.note: died recently, in his eighties; Club Champion; fifth in the 20 miles in 1924 (Windsor Great Park), leading the first Belgrave team to win a Senior R.W.A. Championship; further winning medals 1928 and 1929; later a Judge

share.d: McMullen (father of Dave McMullen) in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1980: 1 mention in 1 issue.
